parsed_beats.scene: Mraka is fiddling with a small device, Tarven observes from his archive station.

exchanges.speaker: Mraka
exchanges.line: This micro-resonator… it’s just not responding. Tools are alphabetized, you know. Every single one.

exchanges.speaker: Tarven
exchanges.line: Indeed. The records are useful, Mraka. Perhaps you are attempting to recalibrate a dampener with a flux coil? It is a common error.

exchanges.speaker: Mraka
exchanges.line: A common error is assuming I make common errors. It's the coupling. It needs… a certain *feel*.

exchanges.speaker: Tarven
exchanges.line: A feel that the records do not detail, I presume. Fascinating. My own analysis suggests thermal variance.

parsed_beats.scene: Sevra is reading to Vresh-Hum-Of-The-Slow-Veins, who is humming a subdued pattern. Renn is nearby, ostensibly cleaning.

exchanges.speaker: Sevra
exchanges.line: ‘…and the starlight, once a comforting blanket, now seemed to stretch thin, brittle.’

exchanges.speaker: Vresh-Hum-Of-The-Slow-Veins
exchanges.line: We-all feel the… stretch. The brittleness. It resonates.

exchanges.speaker: Renn
exchanges.line: Yeah, that… that feeling. Like the whole ship’s hum is a little… off. Off-key, you know? Not groovy at all.

exchanges.speaker: Sevra
exchanges.line: We will find the right key again, Renn. Tomorrow, perhaps.

parsed_beats.scene: Forward is watching the main display, a slight ripple of his ribbon-body. Forty-Seven's presence is subtly noted.

exchanges.speaker: Forward
exchanges.line: The sensor sweep indicates a 0.003% increase in ambient nebula density. Facing forward, this presents a marginal tactical consideration.

exchanges.speaker: Forty-Seven
exchanges.line: By my standards, that is a statistically significant deviation from baseline. I am cross-referencing with historical atmospheric models.

exchanges.speaker: Mraka
exchanges.line: Deviation means something changed. Always something changing. Keeps things… interesting, I guess.

exchanges.speaker: Tarven
exchanges.line: The records indicate many changes, Mraka. Some are more… impactful than others. The present era is certainly marked by impact.
